problem.invalid: This link is not valid. It may have been copied incompletely.
problem.used: This link has already been used. If you checked in with it, the claim is cancelled.
problem.closed: This claim is no longer open, so there is nothing left to cancel with this link.
problem.expired: This link expired when the challenge period ended. You can still open Heirloom and check in from there if the claim has not been finalized.

Alive.wrongChain: This claim is on {chain}. Switch your wallet to that network to check in.
Alive.wrongWallet: Only the owner of the vault ({owner}) can check in. You are connected as {you}. Switch accounts in your wallet.
Alive.done: Your check-in is recorded on the blockchain, so claim #{id} is void and can never be finalized.
Alive.retired: This link is now used up.
Alive.ask: Someone raised claim #{claim} on asset #{asset} of your vault. If you are alive, press the button and confirm in your wallet: that check-in invalidates the claim immediately.
Alive.ends: This link expires when the challenge period ends ({time}).
Alive.endsIn: This link expires when the challenge period ends ({time}, in {duration}).

Invite.invalidBody: It may have expired, been withdrawn, or already been used. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
Invite.bannerGuardian: {inviter} invited you to be a guardian on Heirloom. Sign in below to accept.
Invite.bannerBeneficiary: {inviter} invited you to be a beneficiary on Heirloom. Sign in below to accept.
Invite.copyGuardian: {inviter} invited you to be a guardian. You will hold one encrypted piece of their key and review any claim on their vault. You can never open their files alone.
Invite.copyBeneficiary: {inviter} invited you to be a beneficiary. They are reserving files for you. You will see that they exist, never what they contain, until the guardians release them.
Invite.accepted: You accepted {inviter}'s invitation. When they add you on-chain, it will appear in your dashboard automatically.
